name: Toby Oliver
reason: Mainly therapy and workplace wellbeing rather than spiritual teaching: his own site presents him as a registered therapist (integrative psychotherapy, CBT, medical hypnotherapy, grief counselling, cancer-care counselling) and says his Dru yoga is currently corporate classes and private one-to-ones only, with back-care and grief programmes framed around conditions; his book Rise and Shine (with Kate Oliver) is a personal-development title.
